query.default:
SELECT t.Subject AS [Задача], b.[Status] AS [Состояние], b.[Subject] AS [Тема задания], b.[Created] AS [Стартована], b.[Deadline] AS [Срок], p.Name AS [Исполнитель], CASE WHEN b.[IsRead] = 1 THEN N'Да' ELSE N'Нет' END AS [Прочтена], c.Name AS [Выполнил], b.[Result] AS [Результат], b.[Completed] AS [Выполнена], r.Name AS [Инициатор], b.[Id] AS [Задание], CASE WHEN b.[Completed] IS NULL OR b.[Deadline] IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(day, b.[Deadline], b.[Completed]) END AS [Разница_Дней], CASE WHEN b.[Completed] IS NULL OR b.[Deadline] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, b.[Deadline], b.[Completed]) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(day, b.[Deadline], b.[Completed]) ELSE 0 END END AS 'Просрочено, дней',
CASE WHEN b.[Completed] IS NULL OR b.[Deadline] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, b.[Deadline], b.[Completed]) < 0 THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(day, b.[Deadline], b.[Completed])) ELSE 0 END END AS 'Досрочно, дней' FROM [DirectumRX].[dbo].[Sungero_WF_Assignment] b JOIN Sungero_Core_Recipient r ON r.id = b.[Author] JOIN Sungero_Core_Recipient p ON p.id = b.[Performer] LEFT JOIN Sungero_Core_Recipient c ON c.id = b.[CompletedBy] JOIN Sungero_WF_Task t ON t.id = b.[Task] WHERE b.MainTask IN ( SELECT att.[Task] FROM [DirectumRX].[dbo].[Sungero_WF_Attachment] att WHERE att.[AttachmentId] = @idDoc ) AND b.[Deadline] IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.[Task] ASC, b.[Created] ASC;
